verdict.rationale: Carta documents a dedicated playground environment, separate from production, that mirrors the production experience. Developers create a playground app through the developer portal and later promote it to production, so testing never touches live cap table data. A mock option needs no genuine credentials and returns static but valid responses. missing for 10: evidence that the playground supports stateful write testing beyond static responses, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox's fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Our playground environment provides a similar experience to our production environment.
Register for our developer portal and create your playground app to start building.
Promote your playground app to production in the Developer Portal.
It doesn't require genuine credentials and always returns static but valid responses to your requests.
